items.title: Apple results beat Wall Street expectations on strong iPhone sales
items.description: As it launched its new iPhone 18 Pro models, Apple also increased the price of iPhone 17 models by $100 and increased some MacBook prices, helping soften the blow of memory-chip prices that continued to rise.

items.title: Anthropic revenue hits nearly $17 billion before blockbuster IPO
items.description: Anthropic’s IPO, which will see it and some of its investors sell shares, marks the first listing by a company focused primarily on developing the most advanced AI models

items.description: FM Sitharaman also criticised the Congress party over its approach to the Tata issue, questioning the Opposition's handling of matters taken up through both judicial proceedings and public protests

items.title: Darius Khambata says there was pressure to defer Noel Tata’s appointment as Tata Trusts chairman
items.description: The senior advocate says he seconded Noel’s appointment in October 2024 despite pressure to postpone the decision, while also revealing that he proposed Noel’s son Neville’s induction as a trustee in November 2025.

items.title: Wonderla Holidays turns profitable in September quarter
items.description: EBITDA (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation) rose to Rs 30.11 crore from Rs 15.85 crore a year ago, while EBITDA margin expanded to 24 per cent from 18 per cent.
